facilities.name: Library & Reading Room
facilities.description: A vast collection of over 15,000 books, journals, and digital resources. The library features a dedicated reading room, reference section, and a digital catalogue system for seamless access.

facilities.name: Science Laboratories
facilities.description: Fully equipped Physics, Chemistry, and Biology laboratories with modern instruments and safety equipment. Students conduct hands-on experiments from Grade 6 onwards.

facilities.name: Computer Laboratory
facilities.description: State-of-the-art computer lab with 60 workstations, high-speed internet, and the latest software for programming, design, and digital literacy classes.

facilities.name: Smart Classrooms
facilities.description: Interactive smart boards and projectors in every classroom, enabling multimedia-rich teaching with digital textbooks, videos, and interactive quizzes.

facilities.name: Sports Complex & Playground
facilities.description: A sprawling playground with cricket pitch, football field, basketball and volleyball courts, 200m athletic track, and indoor games room.

facilities.name: Auditorium
facilities.description: A 500-seat air-conditioned auditorium with professional sound and lighting systems for cultural programmes, seminars, and school assemblies.

facilities.name: Art & Music Room
facilities.description: A dedicated creative space with art supplies, musical instruments, and practice areas for drawing, painting, vocal, and instrumental music.

facilities.name: Medical Room
facilities.description: An on-campus medical room with a qualified nurse available during school hours for first aid and health emergencies. Regular health check-ups conducted.
